idea: How to detect a leaking toilet
title: Detecting Silent Toilet Leaks with a Dye Test
description: A practical guide showing how a simple dye test reveals hidden flapper valve leaks between the toilet tank and bowl.
image_prompt: A detailed 9:16 vertical realistic cutaway illustration of a vitreous china ceramic toilet flush tank and bowl in a clean, modern bathroom setting. The cross-section shows dark blue dyed water inside the upper tank. A close-up focus reveals a worn rubber flapper valve at the bottom of the tank with a subtle gap, allowing a steady stream of blue-dyed water to seep through the flush valve channel down into the clear water of the toilet bowl below without the flush handle being activated. Clean professional lighting, physically realistic internal brass and plastic fill valve assembly, detailed ceramic geometry, vertical composition with clear open space at the top and bottom for graphic overlays. Photorealistic style, no text, no visual watermarks, no logos, no fake brand labels.
visual_story: The visual illustrates the internal pathway of a silent toilet leak. By highlighting blue-dyed water seeping past a faulty rubber flapper valve into clear bowl water, viewers immediately understand how water escapes unnoticed without flushing. It emphasizes the direct relationship between tank seal integrity and bowl water migration.

on_image_text.explanation: Dye dropped in the tank seeps into the bowl if the flapper seal fails.
on_image_text.takeaway: Test with food coloring: if dye enters the bowl without flushing, replace the flapper.
